t: This module behaves like the $(l:modules/dropper)Dropper Module/$, except that it also imparts a configurable velocity to the dropped item, potentially throwing the item a considerable distance. You can adjust the item's speed, pitch and yaw via the module's GUI.$(li)Pitch and Yaw are in degrees, relative to a base pitch or yaw.
这个模块的行为类似于$(l:modules/dropper)投掷器模块/$，但它还会给掉落的物品附加一个可配置的速度，从而可能将物品远远抛出。你可以在模块 GUI 中调整物品的速度、俯仰角和偏航角。$(li)俯仰角和偏航角的单位都是度数，且是相对于基础俯仰角或基础偏航角而言的。

$(li)If the module ejects Up or Down, the base pitch is +90° or -90°, respectively. Otherwise, the base pitch is 0°.$(li)If the module ejects Up or Down, the base yaw is the router's facing direction. Otherwise the base yaw is taken from the module's direction.$(li)Example: a speed of 1.0, pitch/yaw of 0°, and a horizontal module direction, will throw an item along the ground for a distance of about 7 blocks.
$(li)如果模块向上或向下弹出物品，则基础俯仰角分别为 +90° 或 -90°。否则基础俯仰角为 0°。$(li)如果模块向上或向下弹出物品，则基础偏航角取自路由器朝向；否则基础偏航角取自模块方向。$(li)示例：速度为 1.0、俯仰角/偏航角为 0°，且模块方向为水平时，物品会沿地面飞出大约 7 格距离。
